defuss-shadcn / Website / Industries / industry-law

Legal Advisor

A one-page site for a small law firm in employment and tenancy law - a deadline check that counts the three weeks for an unfair-dismissal claim, the practice areas with their deadlines, the lawyers with their admissions in profile dialogs, how a mandate works, the fees stated plainly, a consultation request with a callback slot, the questions people ask and the imprint a law firm must publish. Three looks: Chambers, Modern and Paper.

Open full screen

Lindholm & Kaya, employment and tenancy law

The Look select switches the palette, the headings and how the stamp and the margin notes are drawn: Chambers (ivory and bottle green, an oxblood stamp, pencil notes), Modern (white and indigo, a badge instead of a stamp, notes as callouts) and Paper (manila, ink and red pencil, typewriter labels). The deadline check counts from the day a letter arrived - weekends and the public holidays of North Rhine-Westphalia move the last day on. The callback slots are the firm's next office hours in Cologne time.

×%

Built from Site Header (its Sheet holds the navigation on a phone), Section Header, a Card holding the deadline check (Select, Input and an <output>), Service Item (inline) for the practice areas, Team Member with a profile Dialog each, Process Step, Table for the fees, a form of Radio Group, Textarea and Checkbox, FAQ (accordion) and Site Footer with the imprint and the privacy notice as dialogs. The stamp and the margin notes are the page's own CSS, drawn differently in each look.
